decisions.reason: BASE preserves the visual verb 'saw'; SOL changes it to 'heard.'
SOL keeps the Murim setting and uses the project's natural name construction.
SOL keeps the sense of 결과 while using a natural synonym.
SOL preserves the briefly forgotten possibility in more natural English.
SOL faithfully renders doing whatever is necessary without regard for means.
SOL keeps the quiet, self-directed laugh and reads naturally.
SOL preserves the identity of being Murim's Hunter in natural English.
SOL makes the metaphorical boundary between the two identities explicit without changing the sense.
SOL is a natural equivalent of the awakening comparison and preserves the action.
BASE preserves the physical image of the air's flow changing; SOL changes it to a mood shift.
SOL naturally conveys 말을 까 as speaking casually to an elder.
SOL preserves the blunt criticism of the Fire King's terrible training.
BASE preserves the admission that the words slipped out unconsciously; SOL changes the cause to getting carried away.
SOL keeps the image of the two elders glaring angrily in natural English.
BASE preserves 수면 위로, with the shadow wavering over the water's surface; SOL says beneath it.
SOL is a natural rearrangement that preserves the roar's extreme savagery.
SOL keeps the overwhelming qi pressing down on everything and reads naturally.
SOL's 'that single eye' is natural in the immediate description and preserves the image.
BASE better preserves the general groan of 으음; SOL's 'Ngh' suggests a different, injury-like grunt.
SOL naturally preserves that even Supreme Peak masters are not exempt.
SOL preserves the dangling rotten flesh and the comparison while improving the participial flow.
SOL naturally conveys that the Arch Lich was harder to deal with while retaining the comparison of strength.
BASE preserves 고스란히 by stating that the experience was carved into him in its entirety; SOL drops that completeness.
SOL naturally recasts the idiom of experiences becoming flesh and blood without losing the meaning.
SOL carries the deep-breath action into H026, so no source fact is lost by the deletion.
SOL smoothly combines the deep breath with raising White Flame's shaft and preserves both actions.
BASE preserves the unprecedented quality of the internal energy and its being loaded onto the shaft; SOL changes this to merely immense energy poured through it.
SOL keeps the complete surrounding pressure and the shattered-glass image in natural English.
SOL preserves the astonished reaction and the narrator's fixed attention on the dragon more naturally.
SOL naturally conveys Fear preying on inner fears and turning them into terror.
SOL correctly treats the generic fear as something stripped away before recognition.
SOL preserves the fixed gaze with a more vivid but faithful verb.
BASE preserves the voice actively piercing into his ears; SOL weakens the physical and auditory intrusion to merely reaching them.
BASE preserves the causal joke in 그래서 싫으신 건 아니죠?; SOL drops 'because of that.'
SOL explicitly captures 고금제일 with 'past or present' while remaining natural.
SOL preserves the exclusive focus on the result in idiomatic English.
SOL's 'Tssssss!' is a closer natural sound effect for the qi emission than BASE's unrelated chirping.
SOL preserves the atrocious all-DPS party composition in vivid, natural raid language.
SOL's 'lineup' naturally describes the four-person combination without changing the joke.
BASE preserves 미증유의 힘 as unprecedented power; SOL reduces it to merely immense power.
SOL preserves the dragon's badly damaged mouth with a vivid, natural image.
BASE preserves the comparison of vibration by strength; SOL changes 'more powerfully' to 'more violently.'
SOL retains the shout's passage through wind and rain and its reaching everyone's ears.
SOL preserves the mutual killing implied by 죽고 죽이는 싸움 with the natural phrase 'to the death.'
SOL keeps the contrast with the ordinary world and naturally presents this as another raid.
BASE preserves the sense that a familiar face was caught up or involved in the events; SOL changes this to standing at the center.
SOL preserves the heavy figure's movement off flying rock fragments in clear action prose.
SOL naturally renders the wind-pressure blast without changing the tail's physical action.
SOL's parenthetical name placement is natural and preserves the identification of Jin Taekyung.
SOL naturally renders killing the dragon like lightning as dispatching it in a flash.
SOL preserves the warning that an early attack would put the monster on guard.
BASE preserves the difficulty implied by 어렵게 얻은 제자; SOL reduces it to merely finally gaining him.
BASE preserves that Jeok Cheongang was preparing to strike; SOL says he actually thrust out the palm.
SOL keeps the Scorching Yang Qi veering aside and burning the ground in natural active prose.
SOL adds 'once more,' an unsupported recurrence; BASE preserves the eye changing into that of a savage beast.
SOL's pronoun cleanly links the tail to the dragon without changing the action.
BASE preserves the angry exclamation; SOL changes the force of the line into a neutral question.
SOL naturally conveys dodging the monster's body as it crashes toward him.
BASE preserves the misunderstanding of 똥 as taking a dump; SOL repeats 'shitting all over the place' and changes the joke's mechanism.
SOL naturally preserves the recent timing of his worry about his infirmities.
SOL preserves all three tactical orders in concise, natural combat English.
SOL naturally renders following Taekyung's 뜻 as following his lead.
SOL preserves Mungyeong clamping his mouth shut and silently obeying.
SOL naturally conveys Mungyeong being addressed by his bare name.
BASE preserves that Jeok Cheongang understood Mungyeong's feelings; SOL changes this to understanding why he moved.
SOL naturally recasts 묘한 박력 as an almost absurd air of command, preserving the forceful impression.
SOL correctly renders 위압감 as overwhelming presence while preserving the contrast with a Supreme Peak master's bearing.
SOL preserves the newly deployed recruit facing a battle-hardened veteran in natural English.
SOL correctly identifies the twitching corner of Jeok Cheongang's eye and preserves the timing before his anger.
SOL's em dash gives the shouted command natural spoken emphasis without changing its meaning.
